description: This file defines the EmployeeSavedEvent class within the OrangeHRM PIM module, representing an event triggered when an employee's data is saved. It includes a constructor to initialize with an Employee object and a getter method to retrieve that object.

classes.name: EmployeeSavedEvent
classes.description: Represents an event triggered when an employee's data is successfully saved in the system. It extends the generic Event class and holds a reference to the Employee object involved.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSavedEvent with an Employee object.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object related to this event.
